action_args.justification: The series has strong trend and seasonality but low predictability (close to noise), unstable model rankings (Kendall tau -0.12), and highly correlated errors (mean 0.89, only 3 independent groups). The leader (mean over the 9 most stable models) is a seed baseline with an 'indistinguishable' margin over the runner-up. In this regime, a simple robust mean over a moderately-sized stable pool is the safest combination: it avoids overfitting to 3 noisy validation windows while still benefiting from the diversity of the top-ranked models. More complex strategies (fitted weights, per-horizon selection, DBA) would chase noise rather than signal.
